column1: # FROZEN SWIFT ORACLE — produced by running the original Swift maneuver text rules (ManeuverSymbol, LaneGuidance, LaneBox in ManeuverSymbol.swift) at commit 9e8fcef
# (compiled with the test target's Core sources and linked against the Rust bridge; see oracle-harness/maneuver_symbol) before they were replaced by Rust. Do not edit.

# 14610 lines: 2461 u- range records (the regex classes of ICU, which lanePhrase runs on, and of Swift Regex with simple word boundaries, which exitNumber runs on, and Character.isWhitespace, read scalar by scalar), 1948 u-rx-cluster records (the Swift Regex classes of Characters of several scalars), 8229 m, 378 h, 1594 b; three runs, one with SWIFT_DETERMINISTIC_HASHING=1, were byte-identical (sha1 f9e5b96cd68b219a176dcb5a0efa76b05721df99).
